description: This file is a PHP source code defining a controller class 'Online' within the Opencart.Admin.Controller.Report namespace for handling online report views and data retrieval in the OpenCart admin panel.

classes.name: Online
classes.description: Controller class responsible for handling online report pages and AJAX data for the 'online' report in the OpenCart admin interface.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Renders the main online report page with data, breadcrumbs, and UI components.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Handles AJAX request to fetch paginated online customer data and outputs the data view.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Prepares and returns a JSON string containing the filtered list of online customers with details such as customer info, IP, URL, referer, and date added.
